sources.title: Align Attention Heads Before Merging Them: An Effective Way for Converting MHA to GQA
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across diverse natural language processing tasks. However, as the model size and the input sequence's length increase, the linearly increasing key-value (KV) cache significantly degrades inference throughput.
